name: List All Work Orders
description: Returns all work orders that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the work order. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter work orders updated at or after this date-time.

queryFilters.name: filters[CreatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter work orders created at or after this date-time.

queryFilters.name: filters[Status]
queryFilters.description: Filter the results based on one or more statuses. Multiple values should be separated by commas. Enum: "Assigned" "Canceled" "Completed" "Estimate Requested" "Estimated" "New" "Scheduled" "Waiting" "Work Completed"

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of work order objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the work order

responseFields.name: data[].AssignedUsers
responseFields.description: User ID of the AppFolio Property Manager user assigned to the work order. Reference the Users endpoint for any necessary associations.

responseFields.name: data[].AssignedUsers[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the user the work order is assigned to

responseFields.name: data[].AssignedUsers[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The first name of the user the work order is assigned to

responseFields.name: data[].AssignedUsers[].LastName
responseFields.description: The last name of the user the work order is assigned to

responseFields.name: data[].AssignedUsers[].Id
responseFields.description: The UUID of the user the work order is assigned to

responseFields.name: data[].CanceledOn
responseFields.description: The date the work order's status changed to "canceled"

responseFields.name: data[].CancellationReason
responseFields.description: The comments provided by the resident when requesting cancellation via resident portal.

responseFields.name: data[].CancellationRequested
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not cancellation of the work order was requested by the Resident.

responseFields.name: data[].CompletedOn
responseFields.description: The date the work order's status changed to "completed"

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: A timestamp of when the work order's status changed to "new"

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: The top-level description for a grouping of work orders in AppFolio

responseFields.name: data[].EntryInstructions
responseFields.description: The additional information regarding entry to a unit, provided by the tenant when granting permission to enter the residence.

responseFields.name: data[].Estimates
responseFields.description: Use estimates to track anticipated costs for Work Orders. Estimates created via API are not automatically sent to Vendors or Owners, but are visible to assigned Vendors in the Vendor Portal.

responseFields.name: data[].WorkOrderIssue
responseFields.description: The display name of the issue on the work order

responseFields.name: data[].InspectionId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the inspection associated with the work order

responseFields.name: data[].JobDescription
responseFields.description: A brief description of the work order to be performed

responseFields.name: data[].ManagementCompanyAsVendor
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the management company is acting as the vendor for the work order

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy associated with the work order

responseFields.name: data[].PermissionToEnter
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the occupancy has given permission to enter the unit

responseFields.name: data[].PreferredTimes
responseFields.description: An array of preferred time slots as indicated by the tenant. Each time slot is defined by StartAt and EndAt attributes. Only populated when TenantAvailability is set to preferred_times.

responseFields.name: data[].Priority
responseFields.description: The priority of the work order. Enum: "Urgent" "Normal" "Low"

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property where the work order will be performed

responseFields.name: data[].Recurring
responseFields.description: Indicates whether a particular work order is recurring or not

responseFields.name: data[].RequestingTenantId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the tenant who submitted the maintenance request

responseFields.name: data[].ScheduledEnd
responseFields.description: When the work order is scheduled to be completed

responseFields.name: data[].ScheduledStart
responseFields.description: When the work order is scheduled to start

responseFields.name: data[].ServiceRequestId
responseFields.description: The ServiceRequestId can be provided to create a new work order under an existing service request (grouping of work orders).

responseFields.name: data[].SmartMaintenanceIntake
responseFields.description: Indicates if the work order was dispatched through Smart Maintenance

responseFields.name: data[].SmartMaintenanceUrgency
responseFields.description: The urgency level of the work order as determined by Smart Maintenance. Enum: "Low" "Normal" "Critical" "Emergency"

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: The status of the work order. Enum: "Assigned" "Canceled" "Completed" "Estimate Requested" "Estimated" "New" "Scheduled" "Waiting" "Work Completed"

responseFields.name: data[].TenantAvailability
responseFields.description: Indicates when the tenant is available to allow the work order to be completed. Enum: "urgent" "anytime" "preferred_times"

responseFields.name: data[].Type
responseFields.description: The purpose or origin of the work order request. Enum: "Unit Turn" "Resident" "Internal"

responseFields.name: data[].TenantRemarks
responseFields.description: A brief description of the work order by the tenant

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the work order

responseFields.name: data[].VendorId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the vendor associated with the work order

responseFields.name: data[].VendorInstructions
responseFields.description: Instructions for the vendor on how to complete the work order

responseFields.name: data[].VendorTrade
responseFields.description: The type of service offered by the vendor

responseFields.name: data[].VendorPortalLink
responseFields.description: A link to the vendor portal page for the work order

responseFields.name: data[].WithholdApprovedEstimateAmount
responseFields.description: When True, Estimate amounts with the status Approved will be withheld from Owner Distributions.

responseFields.name: data[].WorkCompletedOn
responseFields.description: The date the work order was completed

responseFields.name: data[].WorkOrderNumber
responseFields.description: Sequential number of the work order

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the work order's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the work order page in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].UnitTurnCategory
responseFields.description: The category of the unit turn work order. This field requires a valid UnitId or OccupancyId if provided.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
